label: WTO EX Week 10
method: Add prior actual-minus-projected margin/total errors to this game's saved projected scores. Count winning, losing and push outcomes against the displayed line. Add one prior observation to each possible outcome (two for half-point lines, three for integer lines). Uncalibrated experimental estimates; no Week 6 outcomes used.
limitations: Weeks 2–4 residuals come from a retrospective simulation whose parameters were selected after outcomes.
Week 5 uses archived pregame projections; small sample and changing personnel limit accuracy.
Market is used only as an evaluation threshold. No odds-derived win probabilities.
No automatic model tuning; versioned changes require supporting Tuesday review evidence.
capture_scope: Sunday Week 9 baseline; unchanged model and residuals
